player_prompt.intro:
U n'wi Player {player_id} eka mahlalaganyo ya GameOfPureStrategy.
- U na kheji dza 13 A-K; kheji yin'wana inaweza tirhisiwa kanye.
- Muhlala wun'wana kheji ya mphumphu yi kombisiwa. Tirhisa kheji yin'we kuri ku tsala loko lina bracketed token kufana na '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kheji leyi yi nghenisa mphumphu (na mphumphu lowu wu nghenisiwile). Muhlala wa vun'gani wu nghenisa mphumphu eka mphumphu wa muhla wun'wana.
- Muhlala wa ntsengo wun'wana wa 13 muhla wun'wana wu nghenisa.
